label: South
area: Nakhon Si Thammarat, Hat Yai, Surat Thani
notes: Pak Tai. หรอย = tasty, แหลง = speak, ม่าย = question particle, จังหู้ = very, หลาด = market, หนไหน = where. Sources: Wikipedia, ThaiPod101. Fast, clipped speech; tones differ from Central Thai, so dialect romanization is approximate.
accentHint: Speak Thai with an authentic Southern Thai (Pak Tai) accent: fast, clipped syllables with Southern tones.

female.th: หรอยจังหู้ค่ะ
